malformedAndMissingIds.result: The tool does not fully validate schemas or uniqueness. A probe with a missing exposed item ID and no groups returns valid=true; two linked groups with IDs removed can return valid=true and groupId=null. Missing/duplicate record IDs can also collapse in the owners Map. Recommendation: reject missing/duplicate exposed item IDs and group IDs before interpreting the audit.

cliSafety.result: The CLI runs local synchronous reads/writes and no shell commands; explicit configured artifact output plus --check works. It ignores unknown flags and accepts any --output path, including source paths; recommendation: reject unknown/missing arguments and constrain output to artifacts/ or a caller-approved workspace path.

limitations: Exact aliases are discoverable only among catalog regions referenced by present parts of declared groups; no alias result is not evidence that there are no other aliases or missing continuation groups.
The output is a structural alias-link inventory, not page completeness, semantic source review, or mechanics approval.
The current root-added group is labeled as related Solid Fog context; it does not mark the passage as Death Fog text or transfer field/mechanics grades.
